subject.title: fix(qqbot): add 30s request timeout to token endpoint fetch

question: Should QQBot access-token acquisition unconditionally fail after 30 seconds, matching ordinary QQBot API requests, or use a different bounded control-plane deadline?
rationale: The patch fixes an indefinite channel stall but intentionally changes the behavior of slow existing token requests at an authentication boundary, so the acceptable cutoff is a maintainer-owned compatibility choice.

options.title: Adopt the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Match ordinary QQBot API requests and accept timeout failures for token paths that exceed 30 seconds.

options.title: Use a longer token deadline
options.body: Keep the bounded fix but increase the plugin-local constant for slower proxy or control-plane environments.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Match ordinary QQBot API requests and accept timeout failures for token paths that exceed 30 seconds.
